cohort: Bills from all patients who underwent caesarean sections in September 2021 at Hospital X.
finding: The unit cost of caesarean section calculated using the clinical pathway with the ABC method was found to be lower than the INA-CBGs tariff.
mod_finding: The unit cost of caesarean section based on the clinical pathway method was lower than the INA-CBGs tariff, indicating potential cost efficiency for this mode of birth.
